title: skills: data-hooks api.transaction row should say a body transaction is one datasource and a cross-datasource write is refused (follow-up of #35102)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGvw43spR79ztEvWt

Carries the `Skills-docs:` follow-up of PR #35102 (card #35028, route A). PR #35102 keeps the code and ADR-0119 note; this card owns only the skills teaching.

## What

PR #35102 narrows `ctx.api.transaction` inside an action body: a business write to an object on another datasource inside the body's transaction is refused with `CrossDatasourceTransactionWriteError` (`400 ERR_CROSS_DATASOURCE_TRANSACTION_WRITE`) before anything runs. The skill that teaches the API still describes the callback only as running "in **one driver transaction**" and says nothing about datasources.

- File: `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, the `api.transaction` row (line 334 on `main` when PR #35102 was reviewed; anchor: `one driver transaction`).

## Done when

- The row states: one datasource per body transaction; a write to an object on another datasource inside it is refused with `400 ERR_CROSS_DATASOURCE_TRANSACTION_WRITE`.
- The edit is made after PR #35102 merges (the behaviour it teaches ships there), inside the skills token budget.

## Re-check

`grep -n "one driver transaction" skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` (positive control in the same file: `api.transaction`).
